en: --tab is now a typed enum covering all 10 categories; invalid values exit with code 2 instead of silently scanning nothing
All workspace members share one version, so maclean --version, the Homebrew formula and the release tag finally agree
Windows target compiles again; CI verifies dependency versions stay aligned
Pro app 0.4.2 rebuilt on maclean-core 0.4.2, Developer ID signed and notarized

所有 workspace 成员统一版本号，maclean --version、Homebrew formula 与 release tag 从此一致
修复 Windows 目标编译；CI 校验依赖版本必须对齐
